title: Skill Manifest
description: The canonical declarative unit that travels the graduation chassis unchanged. Every Skill carries exactly one manifest. This is the 'chassis frame' onto which registration, certification, publishing, meaning-sync and composition all bolt. See docs/technical-spec.md.

kind.description: Discriminator. Always 'Skill' for a skill manifest.

identity.description: Who and what this skill is. Stable identity used for lineage and de-duplication.

version.description: Semantic version of this skill revision.

description.description: One-paragraph statement of what the skill does and when to use it.

owner.description: Accountable maker/team. Used for RBAC and graduation hand-off.

handle.description: GitHub/AAD identity of the accountable owner.

skillType.description: Disambiguates the overloaded word 'Skill'. See docs/prior-art.md.

capability.description: What the skill can do, described as IOPE (Inputs, Outputs, Preconditions, Effects) — borrowed from OWL-S so the Reasoning Layer can match and compose. See docs/ontology-schema.md.

summary.description: Capability statement, e.g. 'translate text between languages'.

capabilityTags.description: Canonical capability identifiers used for matchmaking and duplicate detection, e.g. 'translate.text'.

preconditions.description: Conditions that must hold before execution (P in IOPE), e.g. 'user.authenticated'.

effects.description: Side effects/state changes produced by execution (E in IOPE), e.g. 'record.created'.

scoring.description: Determinism and risk scores. Computed/validated at the Certify gate and used by the Compose stage and Ontology Builder Agent.

determinism.description: How deterministic the skill is. 'high' = pure deterministic tool; 'low' = LLM-orchestrated/variable.

risk.description: Blast radius if the skill misbehaves.

reversible.description: True if the skill's effects can be undone.

rationale.description: Short justification for the scores (audited at Certify).

dependencies.description: Other skills/capabilities this skill composes or requires. Drives lineage and composition.

ref.description: Skill id or capability tag this skill depends on.

mcp.description: MCP-compatibility fields. The registry IS an MCP-compatible catalog; we ride MCP for storage/discovery/governance rather than rebuilding it. See docs/prior-art.md.

server.description: MCP server name/namespace that exposes this skill.

toolName.description: Name of the MCP tool that implements this skill, if applicable.

transport.description: MCP transport used to reach the server.

governance.description: Trust metadata: identity, access, cost, audit. The third thing we centralise.

rbac.description: Roles permitted to invoke the skill.

dataClassification.description: Sensitivity of data the skill may touch.

cost.description: Cost signal used by composition to choose between equivalent skills.

lifecycle.description: Where the skill sits on the graduation chassis. Mirrors MLflow registry stages + RPA-CoE gates. See docs/architecture.md.

certifiedBy.description: Identity of the human approver at the Certify gate (human-in-the-loop is mandatory).

supersededBy.description: Skill id+version that replaces this revision (lineage).

type.description: Logical/ontology type, e.g. 'text', 'Location', 'InvoiceDocument'. Ties into the Meaning Layer.
